description: Returns the full public card of one business by its slug (taken from search results or from a laspi.pro/b/{slug} address): description, services, public contacts, city and service languages, as confirmed by the owner. Returns an error when there is no such business.

language.description: Preferred language of the card text (ISO code). The card comes in this language when the owner published one, otherwise in English, otherwise in the owner's own language; `card_language` says which.

name: get_business
title: Get business details
